 Nations League Group A4 
 Norway v Wales (17:00 GMT)
 Live Reporting
 Ian Mitchelmore
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nathan Blake 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio Wales 
 Norway have only been able to execute what they want to do once or twice. 
 It's been an even game so far.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 25 mins 25 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 Kristoffer Ajer is incensed with his defence. 
 It's again a warning sign for Norway.
 6 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 24 mins 24 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Neco Williams puts a foot in to win possession, and he's then fouled and wins a free kick.
 Craig Bellamy has a few words with the fourth official.
 He will be encouraged by how this game has gone so far.
 5 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 23 mins 23 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 Craig Bellamy will be really pleased so far. 
 They have took the sting out of the atmosphere by being really composed on the ball in their own half. That has helped nullify Norway's threat.
 15 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Wales stay patient in possession in the Norway half.
 Ethan Ampadu's cross is blocked by Thelo Aasgaard, but the visitors stay on the attack.
 Norway eventually clear their lines, but Wales come back at them.
 Dan James does so well to shift the ball on to his left foot this time, but he drags his shot just wide.
 8 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21 mins 21 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 Martin Odegaard is really starting to pull the strings now. 
 When he has four assists already in this Nations League campaign, we don't want to be giving him too many more opportunities.
 8 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21 mins 21 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Danny Gabbidon 
Former Wales defender on BBC Radio Wales 
 I have been really pleased with how Wales have started particularly with the ball in our own half. But more quality is needed in the final third. 
 We have been compact and good defensively, but need a bit more belief and intensity in the attacks we are having.
 8 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20 mins 20 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Odegaard plays a lovely floated ball into the Wales box, but Aasgaard can only head over the crossbar from close range.
 After a quiet opening in front of goal, chances are just starting to come for both teams.
 1 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19 mins 19 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 It's a superb counter attack from Wales as Harry Wilson picks out Dan James.
 The winger takes a good touch to shift the ball on to his right foot, and he attempts to loft the ball over goalkeeper Selvik, but he's well off target.
 That was a big opportunity for the visitors though. Norway were well and truly carved wide open there.
 14 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17 mins 17 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 Nusa is the one causing the problems. He is the one who looks like he could be the one to unlock the Wales defence. And Haaland just had a wry smile there as the ball nearly fell into his path.
 6 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16 mins 16 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Wales are getting into promising positions when they commit numbers to attacks, as they just did through Williams and James on the right.
 But Norway recover well, and Ampadu is booked for a cynical foul on Moller Wolfe.
 That's him suspended for the game against Portugal in Cardiff on Tuesday night. A huge blow for Craig Bellamy and Wales.
 6 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16 mins 16 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nathan Blake 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio Wales 
 It's poor defensively from Wales. They need to be aware. Norway get first contact for the second time. Wales need to do a bit better from set pieces.
 1 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15 mins 15 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Ben Davies heads behind for a Norway corner as Haaland prepared to nod Nusa's cross into the net at the back post.
 Superb awareness from the captain.
 Odegaard delivers the corner into the Wales box, but Heggem - the man who was sent off in Cardiff last month - volleys over from the edge of the six-yard box.
 9 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14 mins 14 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Norway look to hit Wales on the counter attack, but Sander Berge can't pick out Antonio Nusa with a through ball.
 No goalmouth action to report as of yet, but Wales will certainly be pleased with their start.
 13 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12 mins 12 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Dafydd Pritchard 
BBC Sport Wales at Ullevaal Stadion, Oslo 
 This is not the first time Liam Cullen, a forward by trade, has played in midfield under Craig Bellamy, who is a big fan of the Leicester player.
 Tonight is one of his toughest assignments yet, up against Arsenal's Martin Odegaard and Sander Berge of Fulham.
 12 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12 mins 12 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Wales play out from the back superbly through Darlow, Davies, Dasilva and Wilson.
 James' cross from the right is cleared, but Wales stay on the attack.
 A good spell for Bellamy's troops here.
 16 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 11 mins 11 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nathan Blake 
Former Wales striker on BBC Radio Wales 
 Dan James and Brennan Johnson need to work incredibly hard today defensively. They need to help out their full-backs. 
 Norway's quality in wide areas means they can't afford to leave them with one v one situations.
 9 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 9 mins 9 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Johnson and Koumas both do well to help Wales get up the pitch.
 Williams plays an early ball into the box from the right, but the delivery is wayward.
 Craig Bellamy applauds the intent though.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 8 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 8 mins 8 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Nia Jones 
Former Wales international on BBC Radio Wales 
 Both teams exchanging blows here as they wrestle for momentum. 
 Antonio Nusa is a live wire. I was glad he didn't start in Cardiff but he is playing tonight and Ampadu did well to block the shot.
 5 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 7 mins 7 mins 
 Norway 0-0 Wales 
 Ben Davies heads the corner clear, but Norway look to recycle possession.
 Wales press well though and counter attack through Dan James on the right wing, although his cross is easily blocked.
